atAGlance: Cá hấp xì dầu is fish steamed with soy sauce, usually with ginger, scallion, onion, and savory juices.
whatItIs: Cá hấp xì dầu is fish steamed with soy sauce, ginger, scallions, and light aromatics. It is clean, savory, and usually ordered to share.
howToEnjoy: Lift the fish gently, watch for bones, and spoon the soy-ginger juices over rice if served. The fish should smell fresh and delicate.
howLocalsOrder: Order cá hấp xì dầu when you want steamed fish rather than fried fish. Ask whether it comes whole, whether bones remain, and for rice if you want to catch the soy-ginger juices.
worthKnowing: This Vietnamese-Chinese seafood style is popular for shared meals because soy, ginger, and scallion flatter fresh fish without burying it.
goodToKnow: Whole fish can have bones; ask whether bones remain if that worries you.
